title: Sargahydroquinoic Acid Suppresses Hyperpigmentation by cAMP and ERK1/2-Mediated Downregulation of MITF in alpha-MSH-Stimulated B16F10 Cells.
authors: Azam, Mohammed Shariful; Kim, Jae-Il; Choi, Chang Geun; Choi, Jinkyung; Lee, Bonggi; Kim, Hyeung-Rak
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物SHQA通过cAMP/ERK通路抑制黑色素生成，涉及PKA蛋白对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，与课题无关。
abstract: Hyperpigmentation diseases of the skin require topical treatment with depigmenting agents. We investigated the hypopigmented mechanisms of sargahydroquinoic acid (SHQA) in alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (alpha-MSH)-stimulated B16F10 cells. SHQA reduced cellular tyrosinase (TYR) activity and melanin content in a concentration-dependent manner and attenuated the expression of TYR and tyrosinase-related protein 1 (TRP1), along with their transcriptional regulator, microphthalmia-associated transcription factor (MITF). SHQA also suppressed alpha-MSH-induced cellular production of cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP), which inhibited protein kinase A (PKA)-dependent cAMP-responsive element-binding protein (CREB) activation. Docking simulation data showed a potential binding affinity of SHQA to the regulatory subunit RIIbeta of PKA, which may also adversely affect PKA and CREB activation. Moreover, SHQA activated ERK1/2 signaling in B16F10 cells, stimulating the proteasomal degradation of MITF. These data suggest that SHQA ameliorated hyperpigmentation in alpha-MSH-stimulated B16F10 cells by downregulating MITF via PKA inactivation and ERK1/2 phosphorylation, indicating that SHQA is a potent therapeutic agent against skin hyperpigmentation disorders.
abstract_zh: 皮肤色素沉着过度疾病需要局部使用脱色剂进行治疗。我们研究了sargahydroquinoic acid (SHQA)在α-黑素细胞刺激激素（alpha-MSH）刺激的B16F10细胞中的低色素机制。SHQA以浓度依赖性方式降低细胞酪氨酸酶（TYR）活性和黑色素含量，并减弱TYR和酪氨酸酶相关蛋白1（TRP1）及其转录调节因子小眼畸形相关转录因子（MITF）的表达。SHQA还抑制了alpha-MSH诱导的细胞环磷酸腺苷（cAMP）产生，从而抑制了蛋白激酶A（PKA）依赖的cAMP反应元件结合蛋白（CREB）激活。对接模拟数据显示SHQA与PKA调节亚基RIIbeta具有潜在结合亲和力，这可能也对PKA和CREB激活产生不利影响。此外，SHQA激活了B16F10细胞中的ERK1/2信号通路，刺激了MITF的蛋白酶体降解。这些数据表明，SHQA通过PKA失活和ERK1/2磷酸化下调MITF，从而改善alpha-MSH刺激的B16F10细胞中的色素沉着过度，表明SHQA是治疗皮肤色素沉着过度疾病的有效药物。
